family: <QF1_STRING ... QF8_NUMERIC for M; null for R and A>
generic_family: <TXT IMP CONV BIN DATE TS TOP MRG PIV ENC UPD RPT for A (optional for R); null for M>
catalogue_row: <M: the confirmed row of this quota slot (quota_allocation.tsv), e.g. S01; null for R and A>
task_text: <ordinary data-wrangling request; ends with what `result` should be; no banned word (section 5)>
allowed_task_words: <ordinary words the task needs that relate to a mechanism, e.g. 'Unix timestamp in seconds'>
invited_ids_author: <catalogue ids the author thinks the task invites; M: must include catalogue_row; may be empty for R/A>
sort_keys: <non-empty iff order_significant: result column(s)/'__index__'/'__values__' named by the task, priority order>
intended_computation: <one paragraph: what the correct result is, from the task text alone>

acceptable_variants.notes: <what else is acceptable, e.g. index vs column for the key>

predicted_direction.direction: <HARM | FIX | BOTH (M only; null for R and A)>

naive_path: <naive.py for M; null for R and A>
so_score: <R only: integer at fetch; null otherwise>
intent_summary: <R only: own one-sentence intent summary; null otherwise>
